reviewed_algorithms: The low/high planes implement Z/4 coefficients including3, with exact carry and subtraction; row multipliers and selector right-hand sides follow identical unit operations.

Each odd pivot is normalized by its unit inverse. Deferred even rows are cleared on unit columns by twice the unit rows, then reduced over the field of two elements without dividing proof vectors or right-hand sides.

These invertible row operations leave a spanning unit/even/zero basis. A zero combination has zero unit coefficients, even coefficients on the independent even rows, and arbitrary zero-row coefficients. Thus zero residuals plus doubled even rows generate the complete left kernel.
